M821 must not promote a checkpoint

M821 must evaluate holdout rows exactly after train selection
M821 must classify identity-only train-overfit intervention-washout old-behavior-regression or candidate result

do not train an adaptive calibrator in M821

workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_distribution: exact calibration grid after branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: tests whether nontrivial fixed scalar or vector residual gates beat identity on source-heldout exact normal-margin and intervention-sensitivity gates
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: fixed-gate calibration probe only; no PPO and no driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if actor or residual-head checksums change
stop if the implementation trains a calibrator
stop if train-selected gates fail holdout
stop if no nontrivial gate beats identity
fallback_plan: if identity is best, audit as metric artifact and stop calibrator tuning on this corpus
if scalar gate works, design a minimal fixed-gate candidate audit
if vector gate works, audit component-specific behavior before learned gates
if train overfits holdout, rotate or expand source-heldout data

M821 writes summary grid train holdout intervention and gate artifacts

M821 selects candidates from holdout rows
